title: 612. Next Greater Element III

examples.explanation: 21 is the smallest larger integer using the same digits.
Descending digits admit no larger permutation.
Pivot swap plus sorted tail yields the next arrangement.

hints: Scan the digits from right to left to find the first rise (a pivot smaller than its right neighbor).
Swap the pivot with the smallest digit on its right that is larger than it, then reverse the suffix.
If the digits never rise, or the result exceeds 2147483647, return -1.
